title: Where You Measure Decides What You Measure: Position Selection in Ablation-Based SAE Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.13337v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse autoencoders are meant to name the things a language model computes, and the usual way to check that a latent matters is to switch it off and see what changes. But a latent fires at many tokens, and the effect has to be measured at one of them. The convention is to measure where the latent fires hardest. That choice is almost never reported, and it is not made by the experimenter: it is made by the dictionary under evaluation. Change the dictionary and the measurement moves to a different token. We show this is not a detail. Take two sparse autoencoders released by Google for the same model and match their latents by decoder similarity: even among the pairs the two dictionaries encode almost identically, they pick different tokens for a large share of them. translated_title: 测量位置决定测量结果：基于消融的SAE评估中的位置选择
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13337v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：稀疏自编码器旨在为语言模型计算的内容命名，而检查某个潜在特征是否重要的常用方法是将其关闭并观察变化。但一个潜在特征会在多个词元上激活，其效果必须在其中一个词元上测量。惯例是在该潜在特征激活最强的位置进行测量。这一选择几乎从未被报告，且并非由实验者做出，而是由被评估的字典决定。更换字典后，测量位置会移至不同的词元。我们表明这并非细节问题。以Google为同一模型发布的两个稀疏自编码器为例，通过解码器相似性匹配其潜在特征：即使在两个字典几乎相同编码的特征对中，它们也会在大部分特征上选择不同的词元。因此，在常规协议下比较两个字典时，往往是在不同位置进行比较。为将惯例与字典分离，我们训练了六个自编码器...
tldr: 本文揭示了基于消融的稀疏自编码器评估中，测量位置由被评估字典决定而非实验者，导致不同字典在比较时往往在不同位置测量，从而影响评估结果的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that in ablation-based SAE evaluation, the measurement position is determined by the evaluated dictionary rather than the experimenter, causing different dictionaries to be compared at different locations, which undermines the validity of evaluation results.
